facts.detail: The Cumbria contract page was published on 2 December 2022.
The page was last updated on 23 November 2023.
Fibrus is the awarded supplier.
The contract value is £108.5 million.
The contract covers up to 59,000 hard-to-reach premises.
The contract was signed on 1 December 2022.
BDUK and Cumbria County Council are listed as collaborating with the supplier.
The first premises were anticipated to gain access in 2023.
Residents and businesses can request service after the network is built.
The premises list is subject to detailed planning and technical change.

facts.detail: The Cornwall contracts page was published on 24 January 2023.
The page was last updated on 12 February 2026.
Wildanet is the supplier named for the two contracts.
The contracts are Lots 32.02 and 32.03.
The two contracts cover southwest and central Cornwall.
Wildanet stated it would not fully complete both builds.
Around 13,200 premises had been covered under the contracts.
A remaining 7,700 contracted premises would not be delivered by Wildanet.
BDUK said it was arranging alternative supplier plans.
The February 2026 update records the changed delivery status.
